# telnyx_sim_card_data_usage_notifications (Data Source)

Lists sim card data usage notifications, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_sim_card_data_usage_notification`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_sim_card_id` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `sim_card_data_usage_notifications` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_data_usage_notifications))

<a id="nestedatt--sim_card_data_usage_notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sim_card_data_usage_notifications`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String)
- `sim_card_id` (String) The identification UUID of the related SIM card resource.
- `threshold` (Attributes) Data usage threshold that will trigger the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_data_usage_notifications--threshold))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--sim_card_data_usage_notifications--threshold"></a>

Read-Only:
